basic_details.job_title: Chennai Port Authority Traffic Manager Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Officers of Major Port Authorities can apply for one post of Traffic Manager (HOD) in the Traffic Department of Chennai Port Authority (चेन्नै पत्तन प्राधिकरण), to be filled by Absorption through Composite Method in the scale of pay of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised). The post is likely to fall vacant with effect from 1 July 2027. Applications are made only on the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways Online Application Portal (OAP), and the applicant's Port must forward the application through proper channel on or before 10 January 2027.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for direct recruitment is 45 years. The RR states that the age limit does not apply in the case of promotion / absorption / deputation.

qualification.details: A Degree from a recognized university. The RR states that this educational qualification also applies in the case of promotion / absorption / deputation.

how_to_apply: Submit the application on the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in. No application other than OAP shall be accepted.
Hand the printout of the application uploaded on OAP to your administrative Port for onward forwarding.
Your Port forwards the application with the documents listed below before 10.01.2027, with the envelope superscribed "Application for the post of Traffic Manager, Chennai Port Authority".

If the application is being forwarded at the last hours, the Port sends it (with its forwarding and the printout of the OAP application) by email, and then sends the complete application with other documents by registered post to Chennai Port Authority.
Copies of ACRs / APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26), attested on each page by an Officer not below the rank of Dy.HoD.
A "No Report Certificate" for any year whose ACR / APAR is pending or not available, along with the ACRs / APARs of the preceding years.
Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, and of present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale.
No objection certificate from the respective Port.
Certificate by the Head of the Office of the applicant (Annexure-II).
Undertaking of the applicant that the candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected.
Vigilance and Administrative Clearance of the concerned Port, in the proforma at Annexure-III.
Two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope.

The Head of Office certificate (Annexure-II) confirms that the particulars are correct, the qualification and caste certificates are verified, no disciplinary / vigilance case is pending or contemplated, the officer's integrity, that no major / minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, and that attested ACRs / APARs for five years are enclosed. The Annexure-III proforma, signed by the Chief Vigilance Officer, covers personal and service details, positions held in the ten preceding years, any listing on the "Agreed List" or "List of Officers of Doubtful Integrity", allegations, punishments, pending proceedings or complaints, and submission of the annual immovable property return under Rule 18 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964.
important_instructions: If an advance copy of an application reaches the Port, the candidature will not be considered by the Ministry unless the application is received through proper channel on or before 10.01.2027. If any major or minor penalty was imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, the forwarding authority may send the disciplinary case and necessary documents with the application. A Port official who withdraws candidature after selection by the Service Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years. Incomplete applications, applications not made following the stated procedure, or applications received after the due date will not be considered. The RR for the post is marked as yet to be notified.

content_sections.heading: About ChPA Traffic Manager (HOD)
content_sections.text: Chennai Port Authority is a Major Port Authority with its Administrative Office at No. 1, Rajaji Salai, Chennai - 600 001. The notice is a circular from the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority, to the Chairpersons of all Major Port Authorities (except KPL), with a copy to the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways and to all HoDs of ChPA for circulation among its officers. The Traffic Manager (HOD) post is classified as Class I (HOD) and is a Selection post for Category-I Ports.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is filled by Absorption through Composite Method from the officers of Major Port Authorities who fulfil the eligibility criteria of the Recruitment Rules (RR) attached as Annexure-I, including the Note in the RR. Applications are invited from suitable and willing officers. A Degree from a recognized university. The RR states that this educational qualification also applies in the case of promotion / absorption / deputation. For absorption through composite method: officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000 with 3 years regular service in the Traffic Department of a Major Port Authority. For deputation: officers holding analogous posts, or officers holding the post of Traffic Manager and equivalent posts in the Traffic Department in the scale of pay of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised) (Pre-pre-revised Rs.18500-23900) with 2 years regular service in the grade. Also for deputation: officers holding the post of Sr. Dy. Traffic Manager and equivalent posts in the Traffic Department in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000 (Pre-revised Rs.16000-20800) and above with 5 years regular service in the grade, in Govt. / Semi Govt. / PSUs or Autonomous Bodies (other than Major Port Trusts). The RR lists the method of recruitment as absorption through composite method, i.e. through promotion / transfer / deputation on absorption basis, failing which deputation, and failing both, direct recruitment. Promotion / transfer / absorption will be from the officers of Major Port Trusts. For direct recruitment, the RR prescribes seventeen years experience in Shipping / cargo operations / railway transportation in executive cadre in an Industrial / Commercial / Govt. Undertaking. The RR states that this experience clause does not apply in the case of promotion / absorption / deputation. The upper age limit for direct recruitment is 45 years. The RR states that the age limit does not apply in the case of promotion / absorption / deputation. The crucial date for determining eligibility is 1 July 2027, the date of arising of the vacancy. Overall grading in the ACRs / APARs must not be below "Very Good". The officer's Port must give Vigilance and Administrative Clearance and a No Objection Certificate. For the full Recruitment Rules of the post, refer to Annexure-I of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected officer will be initially appointed in the HoD post in the scale of pay of Rs.100000-260000 (Pre-revised Rs.43200-66000). After completion of 3 years regular service in the post, the officer will be elevated to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000 (Pre-revised Rs.51300-73000), subject to the conditions in the Ministry's Letter No.A-12023/15/2018-PE-I dated November 19, 2019. The RR lists these conditions for the elevation: Recommendation of the Port Chairperson. APARs of the officer for the last five years not below the benchmark of "Very Good". The officer should be clear from the vigilance angle. Approval of the Ministry. The period of probation is shown as N.A. in the RR. Any changes directed by the Ministry from time to time will be made applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ChPA Traffic Manager (HOD)
content_sections.text: Submit the application on the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in . No application other than OAP shall be accepted. Hand the printout of the application uploaded on OAP to your administrative Port for onward forwarding. Your Port forwards the application with the documents listed below before 10.01.2027, with the envelope superscribed "Application for the post of Traffic Manager, Chennai Port Authority". If the application is being forwarded at the last hours, the Port sends it (with its forwarding and the printout of the OAP application) by email, and then sends the complete application with other documents by registered post to Chennai Port Authority. Copies of ACRs / APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26), attested on each page by an Officer not below the rank of Dy.HoD. A "No Report Certificate" for any year whose ACR / APAR is pending or not available, along with the ACRs / APARs of the preceding years. Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, and of present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale. No objection certificate from the respective Port. Certificate by the Head of the Office of the applicant (Annexure-II). Undertaking of the applicant that the candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected. Vigilance and Administrative Clearance of the concerned Port, in the proforma at Annexure-III. Two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope. The Head of Office certificate (Annexure-II) confirms that the particulars are correct, the qualification and caste certificates are verified, no disciplinary / vigilance case is pending or contemplated, the officer's integrity, that no major / minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, and that attested ACRs / APARs for five years are enclosed. The Annexure-III proforma, signed by the Chief Vigilance Officer, covers personal and service details, positions held in the ten preceding years, any listing on the "Agreed List" or "List of Officers of Doubtful Integrity", allegations, punishments, pending proceedings or complaints, and submission of the annual immovable property return under Rule 18 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the ChPA Traffic Manager (HOD) post is by merit, for which the overall grading in the ACRs / APARs will not be below "Very Good". Applications received through proper channel, even without APARs or vigilance papers, will be taken into consideration by the Ministry, but the Ports must forward the remaining documents without unnecessary delay for consideration of the candidature by the Selection Committee. The notice does not mention an interview or written test.
